title: Scientific Opinion on the re-evaluation of lutein (E 161b) as a food additive
authors: EFSA Panel on Food Additives and Nutrient Sources added to Food (ANS)
funder: European Food Safety Authority, on request from the European Commission (Question No EFSA-Q-2008-787).
result: After uptake into mucosal cells, carotenoids are incorporated into chylomicrons and released into the lymphatics; a significant fraction of the xanthophylls is carried in the blood by HDL. The eye, and the retina in particular, contains high concentrations of zeaxanthin and lutein, which are responsible for the colouration of the macula lutea. The Panel established an ADI of 1 mg/kg bw per day for lutein from Tagetes erecta.
